beats.caption: Drumgowan, in Irish Droim Gamhan, in the civil parish of Donegal and the barony of Tirhugh. Here is the story of Drumgowan and its 23 families, from 1901 to 1926.
The censuses of 1901, 1911 and 1926 counted 61, 44 and 45 people in Drumgowan, in 14, 11 and 12 households. Heads of household included Graham, Boyle and Coulter.
Here are the families of Drumgowan, from 1901 to 1926. First, the Farrell and Graham families.
The Farrell family appear in the records from 1901 to 1926.

Drumgowan had one Farrell household in 1911, headed by Walter.
Drumgowan had one Farrell household in 1926, headed by Walter.
